Independently expanded and checked all three rational differences F2−F0, F0−F1, F2−F1 against explicit P20,P01,P21 with strictly positive denominators. Descartes-sign/root brackets for m=4..10 and polynomial-coefficient discriminant proof for all m>=11 provide exact optima: m4..6 count0 throughout; m7,8 count2→0; m9,10 count2→0→1; m>=11 count2→1, at each crossing precisely two tie. Independent Sympy exact symbolic simplification and rational gain tests corroborate; finite scans do not replace infinite m sign argument.
